//publish: Where the app looks for updates. electron-builder writes this into the bundle as app-update.yml, so it is the feed whether or not CI ever uploads with --publish. GitHub Releases per adr/0002 (8): the repository is public, so this is Fastly's bandwidth rather than ours, and it keeps the Cloudflare Tunnel off the path a church computer needs to update itself.
//mac: zip is not an alternative to dmg here, it is the format Squirrel.Mac updates from: without it electron-builder writes no latest-mac.yml and the updater errors at every check. dmg is what a person downloads. NOTE: macOS updates need a Developer ID signature (a Squirrel.Mac requirement) and this app is still ad-hoc signed, so the check and the download work but the install does not — see the ADR's open questions.
//win: nsis, not portable. portable is a single self-extracting exe with nothing to update in place — electron-updater supports the default NSIS target and does not support Squirrel.Windows or portable. Per-machine install is off for the same reason /Applications was rejected in adr/0002 (5): every update would raise a UAC prompt on a machine where nobody knows the admin password.
//linux: AppImage rather than tar.xz for the same reason as nsis: a tarball is not something electron-updater can update. Linux is not a target platform, but the default config shipped one and a format that cannot update itself is worse than no build at all.
